description: Valorem Soluções Financeiras is a Brazilian financial services company founded in 2000, headquartered in Joinville, Santa Catarina. With over 25 years of operation, the company specializes in providing customized financial solutions focused on solidity, agility, and financial intelligence. They serve businesses, investors, and partners across Brazil, offering receivables anticipation, FIDC investments, debenture investments, card acquiring solutions, and credit securitization. The company positions itself as a strategic partner for consistent business growth through liquidity management.
headquarters: Rua Henrique Meyer, 280 B, 4º andar - Centro, Joinville, Santa Catarina 89201-405, Brazil
business_model: Fee-based financial services including factoring discounts, investment management fees, securitization structuring fees, and merchant acquiring revenue from card terminals
pricing_model: Transaction-based pricing for factoring (discount rates), management fees for investment products, setup/transaction fees for card acquiring, structuring fees for securitization
competitors: FIDC managers like Vinci Partners, Kinea Investimentos
value_proposition: Strategic financial partner combining 25+ years of expertise with customized solutions in receivables anticipation, FIDC/debenture investments, and payment processing — delivering liquidity as a competitive advantage for Brazilian businesses.
rfp_strengths: 25+ years track record in Brazilian financial market
Specialized expertise in FIDC and debenture structures
Full-stack offering: factoring, investments, securitization, and card acquiring
Privately held allowing flexible deal structures
Established presence in Joinville/Santa Catarina business hub
rfp_weaknesses: Mid-size company (51-200 employees) vs. large bank competitors
Brand recognition lower than major banks
opportunities: Growing demand for alternative credit market in Brazil
SME digitalization driving payment solutions demand
Partnerships with fintechs for embedded finance
challenges: Competition from large banks with lower cost of capital
Fintech disruption in factoring and payments
Interest rate volatility affecting factoring margins
Talent retention in competitive financial services market
recent_news: LinkedIn post 2024: 'Empresas que crescem de forma consistente sabem que liquidez não é apenas um recurso financeiro — é uma vantagem estratégica.'
